question.text: In Trade to Trade or Gross obligations method, the member's security pay-in obligation equals:

answer.text: Cumulative sell quantity with no netting against buy transactions
Net sell quantity after netting with buys
The larger of buy or sell quantity
Average of buy and sell quantities

explanation.text: The Logic: Under Trade to Trade or Gross obligations, the member's security pay-in equals the cumulative sell quantity and the security pay-out equals the cumulative buy quantity, with no netting between buys and sells. The Trap: Gross obligation means each trade stands on its own; netting, taking the larger side, or averaging buys and sells does not apply in this method. Note: Pay-in obligation = cumulative sell quantity; pay-out = cumulative buy quantity. No netting is permitted in trade-to-trade/gross settlement.
